notes: Portable core of the repo's xls viewer program: the file-existence guard (filename/fexist/fdelete data _null_) verbatim, then the highlighted-dataset copy `set &argx(obs=1000)`. Clipboard device (filename clp clipbrd), Excel libname and the x-command launcher are Windows/PC-only; &argx (clipboard-fed upstream) is set to a small WORK dataset and the Excel .xlsx target swapped for a CSV via PROC EXPORT. Exercises the guard + macro-var-driven dataset materialization exactly as upstream.
